title: 略式・呼びかけの応用

items.en: Hey, Jen, you got a minute before the meeting?
items.jp: ねえジェン、会議の前に少し時間ある？
items.speak: Hey, Jen, you got a minute before the meeting?
items.note: 元の形: have you got／聞こえ方: ユガラ／使う場面:時間を尋ねる

items.en: Mikey, c'mon, just tell me what changed.
items.jp: マイキー、お願いだから何が変わったか教えて。
items.speak: Mikey, c'mon, just tell me what changed.
items.note: 元の形: come on／聞こえ方: カモン／使う場面:親しい相手を促す

items.en: Boss, I can finish it today if we drop the other request.
items.jp: 上司、別の依頼を外せば今日中に終えられます。
items.speak: Boss, I can finish it today if we drop the other request.

items.en: Liz, you good? You look like that spreadsheet just insulted your family.
items.jp: リズ、大丈夫？その表に家族の悪口でも言われたみたいな顔だよ。
items.speak: Liz, you good? You look like that spreadsheet just insulted your family.
items.note: 元の形: are you good／聞こえ方: ユグッ／使う場面:様子を尋ねる

items.en: Dude, that was supposed to be a quick check-in, not a three-hour meeting.
items.jp: ねえ、簡単な状況確認のはずだったのに、3時間の会議になっちゃったよ。
items.speak: Dude, that was supposed to be a quick check-in, not a three-hour meeting.

items.en: Buddy, don't "sir" me. We shared a desk for two years.
items.jp: ねえ、そんな他人行儀に呼ばないでよ。2年間同じ机を使ってた仲でしょ。
items.speak: Buddy, don't "sir" me. We shared a desk for two years.

items.en: Man, I sent the file to everyone except the one person who needed it.
items.jp: まったく、必要な本人以外には全員にファイルを送っちゃった。
items.speak: Man, I sent the file to everyone except the one person who needed it.

items.en: Babe, I'm gonna be late; the train stopped between stations again.
items.jp: ねえ、遅れそう。電車がまた駅と駅の間で止まっちゃった。
items.speak: Babe, I'm gonna be late; the train stopped between stations again.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:予定を伝える

items.en: Sir, are you asking me to fix the numbers or make them look better?
items.jp: すみません、数字を直せということですか、それとも見栄えをよくしろということですか？
items.speak: Sir, are you asking me to fix the numbers or make them look better?

items.en: Hey, boss, I can take that on, but something else has gotta move.
items.jp: 上司、それは引き受けられますが、代わりに何かを後回しにする必要があります。
items.speak: Hey, boss, I can take that on, but something else has gotta move.
items.note: 元の形: has got to／聞こえ方: ハズガラ／使う場面:条件を伝える

items.en: I don't know. The calendar changed after I left.
items.jp: 分からないな。私が帰ったあとに予定が変わったんだ。
items.speak: I don't know. The calendar changed after I left.

items.en: Beats me. I wasn't in that meeting.
items.jp: さあね。その会議には出てなかったから。
items.speak: Beats me. I wasn't in that meeting.

items.en: No idea. Ask Priya; she keeps track of the changes.
items.jp: 分からないよ。変更を把握しているプリヤに聞いてみて。
items.speak: No idea. Ask Priya; she keeps track of the changes.

items.en: Dunno. The invite just showed up on my calendar.
items.jp: 知らないな。予定表に招待が急に出てきただけ。
items.speak: Dunno. The invite just showed up on my calendar.
items.note: 元の形: do not know／聞こえ方: ダノウ／使う場面:親しい会話

items.en: Hey, Mikey, didja hear who got the account?
items.jp: ねえマイキー、誰がその顧客を担当することになったか聞いた？
items.speak: Hey, Mikey, didja hear who got the account?
items.note: 元の形: did you／聞こえ方: ディジャ／使う場面:くだけた質問

items.en: I can't make the deadline unless someone takes the data cleanup.
items.jp: 誰かがデータ整理を引き受けないと、締め切りに間に合いません。
items.speak: I can't make the deadline unless someone takes the data cleanup.

items.en: I won't make it by Friday if the numbers keep changing.
items.jp: 数字が変わり続けるなら、金曜までには間に合わないよ。
items.speak: I won't make it by Friday if the numbers keep changing.

items.en: I'm not gonna promise Friday until I see the final numbers.
items.jp: 最終的な数字を見るまでは、金曜に間に合うとは約束しないよ。
items.speak: I'm not gonna promise Friday until I see the final numbers.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:約束を避ける

items.en: I can get it done, just not all three versions by lunch.
items.jp: 終わらせることはできます。ただ、昼までに3種類全部は無理です。
items.speak: I can get it done, just not all three versions by lunch.

items.en: Hey, Liz, wanna grab coffee before we pretend that meeting made sense?
items.jp: ねえリズ、あの会議が分かったふりをする前にコーヒー飲まない？
items.speak: Hey, Liz, wanna grab coffee before we pretend that meeting made sense?
items.note: 元の形: want to／聞こえ方: ワナ／使う場面:気軽な誘い

items.en: I'm a little behind, but I'm catching up.
items.jp: 少し遅れているけど、追いついてきています。
items.speak: I'm a little behind, but I'm catching up.

items.en: Running late. Save me a seat if you can.
items.jp: 遅れそう。できたら席を取っておいて。
items.speak: Running late. Save me a seat if you can.
items.note: 元の形: I am running late／聞こえ方: ランニン・レイト／使う場面:急いで状況を伝える

items.en: I was gonna call you, but the client pulled me into another review.
items.jp: 電話しようと思ってたけど、顧客にまた確認会へ呼ばれたんだ。
items.speak: I was gonna call you, but the client pulled me into another review.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ワズガナ／使う場面:予定変更の説明

items.en: Need a hand? You've been staring at that printer for ten minutes.
items.jp: 手伝おうか？もう10分もプリンターをにらんでるよ。
items.speak: Need a hand? You've been staring at that printer for ten minutes.
items.note: 元の形: Do you need a hand／聞こえ方: ニーダヘン／使う場面:助けを申し出る

items.en: Hey, Priya, you got the version with the comments?
items.jp: ねえプリヤ、コメント入りの版を持ってる？
items.speak: Hey, Priya, you got the version with the comments?
items.note: 元の形: have you got／聞こえ方: ユガラ／使う場面:資料を確認する

items.en: Lemme check the thread before I answer.
items.jp: 返事をする前に、やり取りを確認させて。
items.speak: Lemme check the thread before I answer.
items.note: 元の形: let me／聞こえ方: レミ／使う場面:少し待ってもらう

items.en: Gimme a second; I have the wrong window open.
items.jp: ちょっと待って。違うウィンドウを開いてた。
items.speak: Gimme a second; I have the wrong window open.
items.note: 元の形: give me／聞こえ方: ギミ／使う場面:短く待ってもらう

items.en: Whatcha mean by "we'll circle back"? Is there a date?
items.jp: 「また後で話す」ってどういう意味？日程は決まってるの？
items.speak: Whatcha mean by "we'll circle back"? Is there a date?
items.note: 元の形: what do you／聞こえ方: ワチャ／使う場面:意味を確かめる

items.en: Hey, Dan, can you send me the clean copy, not the one with all the notes?
items.jp: ねえダン、メモだらけの版じゃなくて、整えた版を送ってくれる？
items.speak: Hey, Dan, can you send me the clean copy, not the one with all the notes?

items.en: Just talk normally. You don't need to turn every update into a presentation.
items.jp: 普通に話して。報告のたびにプレゼンみたいにしなくていいよ。
items.speak: Just talk normally. You don't need to turn every update into a presentation.

items.en: Don't "sir" me, Dan. We were interns together.
items.jp: ダン、そんな他人行儀に呼ばないで。同じ時期のインターン仲間でしょ。
items.speak: Don't "sir" me, Dan. We were interns together.

items.en: Chill, it's just a draft. Nobody's sending it to the client yet.
items.jp: 落ち着いて、まだ下書きだよ。顧客にはまだ送らないから。
items.speak: Chill, it's just a draft. Nobody's sending it to the client yet.

items.en: Say it like a human, not a slide title.
items.jp: スライドの見出しじゃなく、人間みたいに言ってよ。
items.speak: Say it like a human, not a slide title.

items.en: Wait, what? You want the old numbers in the new report?
items.jp: えっ、何だって？新しい報告書に古い数字を入れるの？
items.speak: Wait, what? You want the old numbers in the new report?

items.en: Say again? The call cut out right when you said the date.
items.jp: もう一度言ってくれる？日付のところで電話が途切れた。
items.speak: Say again? The call cut out right when you said the date.

items.en: You're kidding. They moved the deadline up and didn't tell the team?
items.jp: うそでしょ。締め切りを早めたのにチームに知らせなかったの？
items.speak: You're kidding. They moved the deadline up and didn't tell the team?

items.en: Hey, buddy, can you cover the first ten minutes? My train's stuck.
items.jp: ねえ、最初の10分だけ代わってくれる？電車が止まっちゃった。
items.speak: Hey, buddy, can you cover the first ten minutes? My train's stuck.

items.en: Long story short, the file was fine; we were looking at last month's folder.
items.jp: 要するに、ファイルは問題なくて、先月のフォルダーを見てただけ。
items.speak: Long story short, the file was fine; we were looking at last month's folder.

items.en: Hey, man, let's not guess. We can check the version history.
items.jp: ねえ、決めつけるのはやめよう。版の履歴を確認できるよ。
items.speak: Hey, man, let's not guess. We can check the version history.

items.en: I have no clue why the room's booked. The invite has no owner.
items.jp: 誰が部屋を予約したのか全然分からない。招待に担当者が書いてない。
items.speak: I have no clue why the room's booked. The invite has no owner.

items.en: Could be me. I booked it, then forgot I did.
items.jp: 私かも。予約したあと、自分でやったのを忘れてた。
items.speak: Could be me. I booked it, then forgot I did.

items.en: I wasn't trying to be rude; I just couldn't hear you over the fan.
items.jp: 失礼な態度を取るつもりはなかったんだ。ファンの音で聞こえなかっただけ。
items.speak: I wasn't trying to be rude; I just couldn't hear you over the fan.

items.en: I ain't signing off until somebody checks those totals.
items.jp: 誰かが合計を確認するまでは、承認しないよ。
items.speak: I ain't signing off until somebody checks those totals.
items.note: 元の形: am not／聞こえ方: エイント／使う場面:強い拒否

items.en: They asked me to train the new hire, but nobody's taking anything off my plate.
items.jp: 新人の研修を頼まれたけど、仕事を減らしてくれる人はいない。
items.speak: They asked me to train the new hire, but nobody's taking anything off my plate.

items.en: Hey, Alex, don't let them dump all the follow-ups on you again.
items.jp: ねえアレックス、また全部の後処理を押しつけられないようにね。
items.speak: Hey, Alex, don't let them dump all the follow-ups on you again.

items.en: I'm gonna ask for the priorities in writing this time.
items.jp: 今回は優先順位を文書で確認するつもり。
items.speak: I'm gonna ask for the priorities in writing this time.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:意思を伝える

items.en: They keep saying the team needs to be more flexible, which somehow means we work later.
items.jp: チームはもっと柔軟になるべきと言うけど、なぜかそれは残業するって意味なんだよね。
items.speak: They keep saying the team needs to be more flexible, which somehow means we work later.

items.en: If they want us to stay late, they can at least say why.
items.jp: 残業してほしいなら、せめて理由くらい説明してほしい。
items.speak: If they want us to stay late, they can at least say why.

items.en: Whatcha gonna do if they say no?
items.jp: もし断られたらどうするの？
items.speak: Whatcha gonna do if they say no?
items.note: 元の形: what are you going to／聞こえ方: ワチャ・ガナ／使う場面:次の行動を尋ねる

items.en: Then I'll ask what would have to change for it to be a yes.
items.jp: その場合は、何が変われば承認できるのか聞くよ。
items.speak: Then I'll ask what would have to change for it to be a yes.
